top_signals.title: Pakistan faces pressure to pick a side as Saudi tensions with Houthis escalate
top_signals.summary: Fighting between Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi movement and Saudi forces is increasingly testing how long Pakistan can hold both positions at once.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
